member.name: T:TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActivities.WaitForTaskEvent
member.summary: Implements an activity that takes a specific task ID as input and which is capable of waiting indefinitely for that task to be updated by creating a bookmark for that task event message and then going into an idle state.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActivities.WaitForTaskEvent.#ctor
member.summary: Class constructor -- initializes an instance of the class.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActivities.WaitForTaskEvent.Execute(System.Activities.NativeActivityContext)
member.summary: Performs the actions associated with the activity. This involves creating a new bookmark crafted from the name of the task event message and the specific task id of interest, so that when messages about that task are received by the workflow engine on the enterprise service bus, any instances of workflows waiting on that task can be located and resumed.
member.param: Provides information about the context of the activity and the workflow runtime at the time the activity is actually executed.

member.name: M:TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActivities.WaitForTaskEvent.Resumed(System.Activities.NativeActivityContext,System.Activities.Bookmark,System.Object)
member.summary: Implements a callback method to invoke when the activity is resumed after a task update message is received for the associated task id by the workflow engine.
member.param: Provides information about the context of the activity and the workflow runtime at the time the activity is resumed.
Identifies the actual bookmark that is being resumed.

Specifies any input data being passed into the activity when it's being resumed. This is expected to be a instance corresponding to the associated task id, but may be null. If not value is specified, the activity is expected to look up the associated activity itself if it needs the information.

member.summary: The Id Number of the Task in the form of an argument to be evaluated at workflow runtime.

member.name: P:TrueAutomation.Workflow.TaskActivities.WaitForTaskEvent.CanInduceIdle
member.summary: Indicates whether or not this activity can induce an idle state in the associated workflow. Because that's basically the whole intent of this activity, we return true in all cases.
